Cost: 1,500eb (Very Expensive)
Class: Excellent Quality Very Heavy Pistol
Range: Pistol
Pre-installed: Efficient Autosear, Smart Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Pistol 4)

Can't take Capacity attachments. Single Shot fires a 3-round burst. Autofire uses 6 rounds, not 10 (Efficient Autosear). With a free hand, you can give up your Move Action to reload without an Action.

Foundry notes:

  • CPR 0.92.4 shows a "weapon doesn't support this mode" warning when a pistol Autofires; it's only a warning and the roll still works.
  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
